summary: The revision resolves the previous registration, rollback, gate terminology, and widget diagnostic findings. The implementation contract is sufficiently concrete to proceed; one minor wording inconsistency remains around isolated-content channel availability.

findings.issue: The statement that ui_actions is available in “every run” conflicts with the explicit isolated-content restriction in §4.2. The intended distinction between host declarations and run-level restrictions is otherwise clear.
findings.why_it_matters: Read literally, the new precedence rule could cause an implementer to overlook the existing isolated-content exception.
findings.suggested_fix: Say that widget declarations do not determine channel availability, while format availability remains subject to run-level narrowing, including the isolated-content prohibition.
